verdict: Yes, if you solve breakage. Marbleous from Jaipur pitched marble home decor on Shark Tank India Season 5 and got a deal. Rajasthan's marble craft is world-famous, and marble decor sells at premium prices, but it is heavy and fragile to ship.
angle: Jaipur, Makrana and Agra have skilled marble artisans making everything from coasters to temples. Modern designs appeal to urban buyers and gift shoppers. Invest in strong packaging and insured shipping.
